sentences.text: Just-measure is a cohort company whose country is recorded as DK, and the sources we read hold no register entry for it.
The record has a product launch and another dated event, both on 2026-07-15, and an exhibitor or demo entry dated 2026-08-19.
A programme-entry record on the apelago.fi site is dated 2026-02-09.
No funding, patent or contract record is on file, so every readiness level is unknown.
For the fund this stays on the watchlist until a public funding or customer record appears.
